metadata.cost_note: Reported wall times sum sequential heterogeneous-host stages; no speed comparison implied. Reuse/amortize both stages for all methods.
metadata.selection_note: Policies chosen from recorded TRAIN0-7 routing scores; base static policy was trained on0-31. No validation or final test selection.

backend: ToolingFactory hard homes; no kitting, no QA guard; exact selector at every other tick
selection: First two chronological coupled boundaries per trace with2–4core and≤5totalbits
oracle: Offline realized-future continuation oracle among one-tick feasible core subsets; not causal deployment or global optimum
prefix_scope: Physical commitments/observations strictly before target tick; full target pool also hashed

problem.variable_order: candidate bits in listed order, followed by slack bit indices

sampling.backend: Python exact statevector + seeded Born sampling
sampling.bit_order: basis index bit i is qubit/variable i; count strings read q[n-1]...q[0]

optimization.objective: exact noiseless statevector expected QUBO energy

circuit.bit_order: basis index bit i is qubit/variable i; count strings read q[n-1]...q[0]

limitations: This is a classical simulation of a quantum circuit, not a physical ODRA5 run.
At most five total encoded variables are sampled; the full factory is handled by classical state/constraint machinery.
Exact enumeration is an evaluation reference, not the source of the selected actions.
Best feasible selection over many shots is classical postselection; the equal-shot uniform baseline is reported.
The candidate pool and frozen boundary restrict available actions; pool-optimality is not global scheduling optimality.
